image_prompt.text: A chain of platforms spiralling upward around the tower, spaced to the physics limits — the ordered route through the climb
Platforms on the spiral that vanish after being stepped on, or a set time after activation, so the climb has to keep moving
Trusses, ladders, tightropes, and wall scrambles up the tower's core between spiral sections

notes: Preset Tower Obby taken on its own shape course-tower; dropped its winner-zone because a tower that spirals up endlessly has no top and so no end reward area.
"Endlessly" read as a procedurally extending climb, not an auto-run runner — forward motion is the player's, so this stays Obby & Platformer rather than Infinite Runner.
course-tower carries P2 because the spiral puts platforms directly above each other; not an override case, the overhang is real.
